description: Returns what Plendio knows about an online shop, given its domain: its name and country, whether and to which markets it ships, shipping fee, free-shipping limit and delivery time where the shop has stated them, its returns text, how many products it lists, how often it is the cheapest, shoppers' reviews on Plendio and the url of its store page. Shipping, returns and trust marks are the shop's own statements and are not verified; a field is absent when the shop has not stated it.

host.description: The shop's domain, e.g. elgiganten.dk (a full address is accepted).

market.description: Market the shopper is in, for the ships-to answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

name: get_store

country.description: ISO 3166 country the shop is in.

price_position.description: Present when enough products are contested for the figure to mean something.

cheapest_on.description: Products on which this shop has the lowest price.

compared_on.description: Products where at least two shops compete.

returns.description: The shop's own returns text, clipped. Written by the shop.

fee.description: Standard shipping fee in major units of currency, as the shop stated it.

free_from.description: Order value from which shipping is free.

text.description: The shop's own shipping text, clipped. Written by the shop.

ships_to.description: Markets (dk, se, de, no) the shop ships to.

ships_to_market.description: yes when the store index lists the market among the shop's delivery countries, no when it lists others, unknown when it lists none.

company_number.description: Company registration number the shop gave.

emaerket.description: The shop says it carries the Danish e-commerce label (E-mærket). Not verified.

page_claimed.description: True when the shop has proved it runs its store page on Plendio.

trustpilot_url.description: The shop's own link to its Trustpilot page. Not verified.

url.description: The shop's store page on Plendio.

title: Get a shop's details
